Get the AI on your phone
Open Engine: the small model dot at the top of a page, or Engine at the bottom of the sidebar.
Attune picks the best model for this phone. Tap Download — once, on Wi-Fi.
When it says Ready, everything works with no internet, and nothing you type leaves the phone.
Bigger is smarter but warmer: Spark and Glow are light, Core is the everyday choice, Zenith wants 12 GB of memory or more.
Tap ☰ at the top to open the sidebar (on a computer it is always on the left). It has 8 places: Create · Projects · Home · Students · Money · Health · Daily · Work.
Each place is one page with tabs on top. Money = Money · Follow-ups · Deal Check. Work = Business · Team records · Reports · Tools.
At the very bottom: How to use Attune, Privacy, Engine, Backup and Settings. Back always takes you to the page before.
Every guide here ends with Open it — it takes you straight to that tool.
Type or say what happened in the Home box: “had foul and 2 eggs”, “spent 150 on lunch”, “took my insulin”.
Attune puts it in the right place — Fit & Food, Money, Family health, Reminders, People & plans, Dates — and says what it did. Wrong? Tap Undo.
Under the box: three quick starts (Food photo, A file, Find for me), “Attune suggests” with what is waiting today, and four tiles with one number each.
One sentence can do two things: “koshary for lunch, 80 pounds” goes to Fit & Food AND Money.
Home → Chat. Type, or hold the microphone and speak — Arabic or English.
+ adds photos or files: Attune reads them and answers about them.
Leave it on Auto: it picks the model, the web and thinking for each question. Deep answer is for a big question.
Say what you want done, not just the topic: “compare these two cars for a family of five” beats “cars”.
Settings → Attune keyboard → Turn on, then Switch to it. It works in WhatsApp, Gmail — every app.
Above the keys: Improve, Translate, Reply and Prompt — done by the model on your phone, offline.
Tap the Franco chip again to type plain English.

en: Everything is kept on this phone only. Backup (bottom of the sidebar) saves all of it in one file.
New phone? Open that file there and all your data comes back.
Your Profile (name, country, language) makes every answer fit you.
Make it a habit: one backup every Friday, saved somewhere off the phone.
The box that does it all, quick starts and what is waiting today
Ask anything — with photos, files and the web
Spending, bills, Zakāt — and what is safe to spend today
Food, medicines and cycle on one page
Prompts, compress, humanize, copilot, library, video
What stays on your phone — and locking places with your fingerprint
Machine health from your team's site reports
Incident and maintenance reports from what you say
Type or say anything in the box — “remind me at 5 to call mum”, “spent 200 on petrol”, “find me a used Corolla”.
“Attune suggests” lists what is waiting today: a bill, a dose, a trial that ends. Tick Paid or Done right there.
The four tiles (Money, Health, Daily, Work) show one number each — tap one to open it.
Start every morning here — it is your day on one screen.
Type or hold the microphone and speak; + adds photos and files.
Auto picks the model, the web and thinking for you; Deep answer reads many pages for a big question.
Ask about your own things (“what did I spend on food this month?”) and the answer comes from your data.
👎 on a wrong answer and say why — Attune remembers the fix.
Ask in your own words: “who owes me money?”, “is mum's sugar better?”, “what's due this week?”.
Attune finds the answer in your own records — Money, People & plans, Family health, Fit & Food, Dates, Mind — and does the sums by code.
Tap Open to see where each number came from.
Ask how something changed — “food spending since Ramadan”, “my spending by month” — and you get a chart, every number from your own records.
Type text, open a PDF or Word file, or take a photo of a sign or a menu.
Every part is checked, and the document keeps its layout.
Conversation: two people, one phone — each taps their side and speaks; the other reads it and hears it.
Share text or a photo to Attune from any app — or paste it here.
Pick an action: summarise, reply, translate, find the address, add to the calendar.
The result is ready to copy or send back.
Pull down the quick settings and add the “Attune Instant” tile: one tap opens Instant over any app.
Make a book for a subject — work, recipes, a course.
Add notes and pages to it; they stay in order.
Review: your notes come back on the day you are about to forget them — tap Forgot, Hard or I remembered.
Export a book as a document or share it. Five minutes of Review a day and what you read stays with you.
Check the line it shows, and tap Turn it on. It needs Notification access (the same switch Money uses).
When your bank's notification comes, you get Attune's notification at once; the money goes into the pot when Attune opens.
It runs on the phone with no AI and never reads your messages app.
Tap Add screenshots once to bring old ones in, and switch on Keep my notifications (30 days, never SMS).
Everything stays on the phone — turning notifications off forgets them.
Every time Attune opens it reads your Money, your Fit weights and Scout's market book, and shows your real chance (from your own past days, thousands of possible futures) and your progress.
You get ONE step for today — “spend 2,925 less a month on food → 68%”, or move the date when it is out of reach. Why shows the proof.
Before a big decision — cash or installments, a new flat, a second car — open “Test a big decision”: 2,000 futures from your own money, with stress tests.
Pick a ready expert or make your own with instructions.
Chat with it — it follows those instructions every time.
Add files it should always know.
Tap 👎 on a wrong answer in an assistant's chat and write the right one — the assistant keeps it as a rule. Share an assistant as one file.
A skill is a saved recipe for the AI: the steps it follows for one kind of job.
Create one, import one, or pick from the list.
Use it from Chat — and share it with friends.
Skills make a small model act like a bigger one on that job.
Pages, documents and small programs Chat makes are kept here.
Open one to use it, change it or share it.
Ask Chat to change it and a new version is saved.
Ask Chat for “a page that tracks…” — what you type into it is kept, and Home screen puts it on your phone like an app.
Describe a picture — in any language.
A quick draft shows first, then the clear picture.
Keep it, draw again, or change a photo with one instruction.
